capture_workflows_engagement_events.description: Capture email sends, opens, clicks and bounces as PostHog events, so they can be used in insights and funnels. These events count toward the project's event usage.

email_tracking_consent_mode.description:
Whether tracking opens and clicks on marketing email needs the recipient's consent. 'off' follows each email step's own setting, 'opt_out' tracks unless the recipient objected, and 'opt_in' tracks only recipients who consented. Transactional email is never affected.

* `off` - Off
* `opt_out` - Opt Out
* `opt_in` - Opt In

expected_project_id.description: Optional. The project_id from the rules being changed. The update is rejected when it does not match the current project, so a change never lands in a project the user did not look at.

marketing_frequency_cap_max_messages.description: The most marketing messages one person gets in the window, across all workflows and broadcasts. Set it together with marketing_frequency_cap_window_days, or set both to null to turn the cap off. Transactional messages are never capped. The recommended cap is 1 message every 2 days.

marketing_frequency_cap_window_days.description: The length of the rolling frequency cap window, in days. Set it together with marketing_frequency_cap_max_messages, or set both to null to turn the cap off.
